claims: Assess hemodynamic status given persistent hypotension (MAP 57-65 mmHg) and initiate or titrate vasopressor support as clinically indicated.
Transfuse packed red blood cells for symptomatic anemia with hemoglobin 7.1-7.7 g/dL in the setting of critical illness.
Monitor arterial blood gases and lactate to assess oxygenation and perfusion.
Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and monitor ventilator parameters.
Assess and manage pain with multimodal analgesia, considering the reported moderate to severe pain.
Monitor blood glucose and administer insulin per sliding scale or protocol.
Replete electrolytes, including potassium and magnesium, as indicated by laboratory values.
Continue infusion of nicardipine for blood pressure control as ordered.
Monitor coagulation parameters (PT/INR, PTT, fibrinogen) and consider reversal of coagulopathy if clinically indicated.
Assess and manage volume status, considering diuresis with furosemide as ordered and monitoring response.
